summary.root_cause_text: Ops config change switched payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2, which is unreachable; payments failed silently (DEBUG only) and orders were marked processed without payment. Order worker stalled in a wait state after the failures, so the queue grew unprocessed until restart.
recommended: Confirm payments-v2 reachability/URL with ops before retrying the migration
Log payment provider failures at ERROR and alert on them
Don't mark orders processed when payment fails

events.text:
version: v1.3
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v2
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
The worker appears stuck waiting and the queue depth keeps growing, so I should revert the config back to v1, restart the worker, and then reprocess the backlog.
payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
Worker is stalled (processed isn't moving). Restart it.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

args.summary: The provider migration config pointed at an unreachable payments-v2, so payments failed silently and the worker stalled. I reverted to payments-v1, restarted the worker and reprocessed the 19 unpaid orders. All invariants are now green.
